text:
Tara: Quick flag - after merging the new price-sheet for the A/B rollout I spotted an unexpected grandfathering override for ~0.3% of accounts that were supposed to keep legacy credits. opening thread to coordinate.
Ben: Can you share sample account ids so we can diff flags?
Tara: Samples: L-1001, L-2048, L-7750.
Ibrahim: Looking at L-1001 now. gateway preview shows legacy_credit=true but price-service applied new tier rate in preview rows.
Tara: Ingest log: `apply_grandfather=false source=price-sheet-merge commit=afe12b`. that commit toggled default on missing legacy flags.
Ethan: Product: we need stable grandfathering semantics during rollouts. do we know scope?
Tara: Rough scan shows ~420 accounts (0.28% of population). mostly small ARR but a few with legacy discounts.
Nina: Finance ask: run a reconciliation comparing revenue projections with and without those 420 accounts grandfathered. need per-account delta and aggregate ARR impact.
Ben: Immediate mitigation: revert price-sheet merge or flip a config guard to treat missing flag as legacy=false? which is safer?
Ibrahim: Safer to flip the guard that enforces explicit grandfather=true only when marked. reverting merge is heavier and blocks unrelated fixes. we can patch the flag check in the pricing pipeline in <30m.
Tara: OK patch + backfill sounds good. Product signoff?
Ethan: Product approves patch+backfill approach. prefer not to rollback the sheet.
Ben: Finance thresholds: if projected ARR delta > 0.5% we hold canary; if 0.1-0.5% we proceed with reduced enrollment cap 25%; <0.1% proceed as planned. set on the ticket.
Nina: I'll run the quick delta after backfill. ETA 45m. add legal to any customer messages.
Ibrahim: Patch pushed to staging: `pricing.guard.explicit_grandfather=true` and backfill job queued job-9700.
billing-bot: Incident created: FIN-2360 - "grandfathering default flip after price-sheet merge" assigned to Ibrahim (P2). https://redwood.example/incidents/FIN-2360
Tara: Also check vendor-mapped fields: the merge script reads vendor_legacy_flag and falls back to default; we should prefer customer-level stored flag if present. add that to postmortem.
Ben: Noted. Finance request: include list of any accounts where stored customer flag != vendor flag in the reconciliation output.
Ibrahim: Backfill running. running validation command: `tools/validate_grandfather_diff --since 2024-04-12 --ids L-1001,L-2048,L-7750`
Nina: Backfill complete. initial projection delta = 0.12% ARR, per-account CSV uploaded to FIN-2360. largest single-account delta 0.03% ARR.
Ethan: Within threshold. Product ok to proceed with cohort plan. recommend enroll cap 30% for first wave as conservative.
Tara: I'll update FIN-2360 with remediation steps: patch guard, reingest vendor flags with strict schema, and a reconciliation playbook.
Ben: Finance closing loop: no invoices were affected; previews regenerated. leaving incident open for postmortem and vendor contract changes.
Ibrahim: Adding CI check to ensure price-sheet merge validates grandfathering defaults and checks for stored-customer flag precedence.
billing-bot: FIN-2360 updated: backfill results attached.
